summary.text: Adds a Microsoft Entra access policy to a Connector Namespace connection.

remarks.text: Access policies authorize a specific Microsoft Entra principal to use the connection. They do not perform connector OAuth consent and should be limited to principals that require access.

members.name: WithAccessPolicy

summary.text: Adds a Microsoft Entra user or group access policy to a managed MCP server configuration.

remarks.text: Managed MCP endpoints reject callers that do not have a config-scoped access policy. Connector Namespace currently supports Microsoft Entra users and groups for these policies. The Azure child resource name is set to the principal object ID as required by the service.

returns.text: The MCP server configuration resource builder.

name.text: The Aspire resource name for the policy.

summary.text: Adds a connector route and an explicit operation allow-list to a managed MCP server configuration.

remarks.text: Connections and MCP server configurations are separate Azure resources so a connection can be reused independently. This method links the MCP server configuration to its underlying connection and exposes only the operations listed in

as MCP tools. Operation IDs are connector-specific and should be verified against the connector operation metadata. The current Connector Namespace preview supports one connector per managed MCP server configuration.

returns.text: The MCP server configuration resource builder.

connection.text: The connection used by the connector route.

options.text: The connector metadata and operation allow-list.
